pages.title: Where to find
pages.text: Use this encounter’s locator in the Nether. It marks the site on your map; the locator itself does not begin combat.

pages.title: How to fight
pages.text: The Piglin Executioner rejects fire contact. A hit also invokes a native response that receives the attacker; one accepted hit is not a safe opening for an endless combo. Bring healing and leave an exit from melee range.

pages.title: What does not work
pages.text: It marks the site on your map; the locator itself does not begin combat. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory.

pages.title: Drops
pages.text: Native loot for this encounter includes: Piglin Executioner Trophy, Music Disc. Inspect the obtained item’s uses in JEI to choose your next equipment. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory.
